name: Nonaka Yousuke
source:
Misato's student, a boy who still retains a childlike innocence. He has a somewhat slow-witted personality and is Kenya's childhood friend and best buddy.

He's particularly favored by Nanana and was the first to lose his virginity.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698875&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
